title: Scheduled Tasks
subtitle: Prompts run automatically on schedule (directly against the selected model locally). Scheduling works while the app is in the foreground; run history is fully retained.
promptPlaceholder: Add a prompt (the AI will run it on schedule and keep the result)
emptyTasks: No scheduled tasks yet. Click "New task" at the top right to create one.
emptyFiltered: No tasks match the current filter
loadFailed: Failed to load the task list
namePromptRequired: Task name and prompt are required
createdNotice: Task created and enabled. It will run automatically on schedule.
deleteMessage: Delete scheduled task "{name}"? Its run history will be deleted too.
allowExternalHint: Off by default. When off, commits/pushes/MCP writes/PR comments are blocked and collected into a pending-actions list for your review instead of running unattended.
allowExternalConfirm: "{name}" will run commits, pushes, MCP writes and other external actions unattended, without waiting for you. Turn it on?
triggerEventHint: When on, the task no longer runs on a clock; it runs when a matching event is delivered to the local event endpoint.
eventExample: Example: source github + event pr_opened. Events are de-duplicated by id and merged (no queueing while the task is running).
eventRequired: Event-triggered tasks need both a source and an event name
modelFollowSession: Follow the model selected in chat
modelHint: Leave as-is to follow your current chat model; pick one to pin this task to it. The number in brackets is its context window.
modelTooSmall: This task handles about {n} items but the selected model only has {win} of context. The agent will batch automatically and can restart up to two times, yet it may still not finish — a larger-window model is much safer.
autoLaunchHint: Launch MJ Nexus at login so scheduled tasks stop being missed while the app is closed
cronPlaceholder: Cron expression (5 fields: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 9 * * *)
cronFiveFields: Cron needs 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday)
cronFieldChars: Fields may only contain digits, *, commas, - and /
recoverTitle: Task storage was wiped — the backup still holds {n} task(s)
recoverHint: The last abnormal exit wrote an empty store. You can restore from the backup (please verify the tasks afterwards).
modelWindowUndeclared: This model has no declared context window, so {win} is only an estimate (values marked with ~ are estimates). Confirm it in "Models → Context window" so batching and compaction use the real size.
expectsFileHint: On by default. When on, a run that produced no file is marked failed (so "succeeded but generated nothing" cannot slip through). Turn it off for tasks that only commit or only report.
expectsFileOff: Output files not verified (other failures still fail)
expectsFileOffShort: Output: not verified (other failures still fail)
